Title: Public preview: Azure Percept DK September (2109) software update is available

Body.Content:
OTA package and USB cable update image are available in public preview. Please be sure to check the update strategy guidance before choosing between the two update methods. Updates are highly recommended in order to keep your device up to date with latest fixes and features.

Read the release notes.
